label: سوق خضار
parking: Park stationary parallel to an existing sidewalk curb with straight wheels 20–30 cm from the edge, not blocking the entrance.
ground: Weathered faded Saudi asphalt, irregular repair patches, dust and worn beige-gray interlocking sidewalk with approximately 15 cm concrete curb.
background: Ordinary a vegetable market details, everyday pedestrians, parked vehicles and surfaces only if naturally visible inside the unchanged selfie framing; no named landmarks.
angleReason: Face-dominant handheld front-left driver-seat selfie preserves actual left-side steering geometry.

day.source: Natural single-source 5500K daylight; shade only from actual walls, trees or roof present in frame.
day.shadows: One coherent direction away from actual daylight, with realistic contact shade.
day.reflections: Soft restrained natural reflections in glass and pearl-white paint.

night.source: One existing local building or street fixture, warm 3000K, shadows facing away from it.
night.shadows: One shadow direction away from the actual installed fixture.
night.reflections: Localized muted highlights on paint and side windows, no fill.
